mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submission (username, experiment_id, code, report, submit_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{experiment_id}, #{code}, #{report}, #{submit_time})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM submission WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY submit_time DESC

SELECT stu.student_id as 学号, class_name as 班级, submit_time as 提交时间, `code` as 代码, stu.`name` FROM student stu,score s, student_code sc WHERE stu.student_id = #{username} and sc.experiment_id = #{experimentId} and stu.username = s.username and s.username = sc.student_id ORDER BY submit_time DESC LIMIT 1
